defects.description: Flush resets the submission's consumed attempt count, permitting unlimited dependency calls across unsuccessful flushes.

trigger.input: Inject an always-unsuccessful counted client with attempts=2; enqueue once and flush three times.

defects.why_missed: No failing client adapter exists in the suite; default submissions succeed immediately.

defects.description: Refresh rereads all history instead of advancing its read position.

trigger.input: Supply a store filtering sequence > after; refresh records 1 and 2, append record 3, then refresh again.
trigger.expected: Second read starts after 2 and returns only 3.
trigger.actual: Second read starts after 0 and rereads 1 and 2.

defects.why_missed: The suite has no store adapter or retained history; the default store is always empty.
